classification_notes: Tottenham's revenue note mixes gate receipts with domestic prize money and separates UEFA solidarity and prize money from media and broadcasting. For comparability, UEFA solidarity and prize money has been grouped with broadcasting, while the domestic cup gate receipts and prize money line has been kept within the matchday-style bucket and should be treated as a medium-confidence mapping.
women_team_treatment_notes: Women's team revenue is not separately disclosed in the report.
non_football_revenue_notes: The 'Other' revenue line is included within commercial revenue because the club does not separately disclose a clearer commercial subcategory breakdown for that amount.
source_document: Group of companies' accounts made up to 30 June 2012
notes: Values in the annual report were disclosed in GBP thousands and have been converted here into full GBP amounts by multiplying by 1,000. Revenue category mapping requires some reclassification because Tottenham's note does not align perfectly with the standard matchday/broadcast/commercial split.
